title: A Sober Look at Progress in Language Model Reasoning: Pitfalls and Paths to Reproducibility
authors_zh: Andreas Hochlehnert, Hardik Bhatnagar, Vishaal Udandarao, Samuel Albanie, Ameya Prabhu, Matthias Bethge
paper_type_zh: 审计、污染或验证器鲁棒性论文
best_for_zh: 想复盘验证器、基准污染、奖励投机或可复现性风险的研究者。
one_line: Audits reasoning-model progress claims by showing that benchmark results can be highly sensitive to decoding, seeds, prompt format, and environment details.
指出解码、随机种子、提示格式和运行环境都可能改变推理结论，是复现与比较模型进展的基础审计读物。
why: It is an audit anchor for this atlas: reasoning-data claims need reproducible evaluation settings, not just headline benchmark gains.
inclusion_reason: Core reproducibility and evaluation-audit reference for reasoning benchmarks, RL claims, SFT comparisons, and reporting standards.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Mathematical-reasoning leaderboards often compare models under different decoding settings, prompts, seeds, answer extractors, and compute stacks. On small test sets, these hidden choices can move Pass@1 enough to reverse rankings, so reported gains cannot be cleanly attributed to a training recipe.

The paper addresses this as an evaluation-audit problem: it systematically varies those choices, proposes a standardized reporting protocol, and re-evaluates recent RL and SFT reasoning models. Its direct outputs are a reproducible evaluation stack, released prompts and outputs, and a standardized result collection. Without this control, users may adopt an ineffective post-training recipe, and the field may optimize against a noisy leaderboard instead of a reliable improvement.

数学推理榜单常在不同解码参数、提示格式、随机种子、答案提取器和软硬件栈下比较模型。小测试集会放大这些隐藏差异：Pass@1 的变动足以调换排名，因而难以把报告的提升干净归因于训练配方。

论文把它作为评测审计问题处理：系统改变上述条件，提出标准化报告协议，并重新评测近期 RL 与 SFT 推理模型。直接产物是可复现评测栈、公开提示与输出，以及统一条件下的结果集合。 若不控制这些条件，使用者可能采纳无效的后训练配方，领域也可能围绕含噪榜单优化，而非围绕可复核的真实改进迭代。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The contribution is an audit surface for mathematical-reasoning progress: a fixed evaluation protocol exposes how much an apparent gain depends on evaluation choices rather than a model change. The paper standardizes seeds, model-specific decoding, prompt templates, answer matching, and the execution stack, then contrasts RL and SFT variants on shared benchmarks. Its released Sober Reasoning dataset contains 65.6k CSV evaluation-log rows with model, benchmark, seed, decoding, accuracy, and runtime fields (MIT); it supports evaluation analysis, not SFT or RL training data. The feedback contract is deterministic answer matching plus repeated-run uncertainty reporting, so a record is evidence about a configured evaluation run rather than a label of intrinsic model quality. This makes the Card most useful as a reproducibility and comparison reference.

核心贡献是为数学推理进展建立审计面：固定评测协议后，可分辨表面提升究竟来自模型变化，还是评测选择。论文统一随机种子、按模型调优的解码、提示模板、答案匹配和运行栈，再在共享基准上比较 RL 与 SFT 变体。其开源 Sober Reasoning 数据集含 65.6k 条 CSV 评测日志，记录模型、基准、种子、解码、准确率和运行时间，采用 MIT 许可；它服务于评测分析，并非 SFT 或 RL 训练数据。 反馈契约是确定性答案匹配加重复运行的不确定性报告，因此每条记录证明的是一个已配置的评测运行，而不是模型内在质量的标签。 因此，本卡最适合作为复现与横向比较的参考，而非性能排行榜的替代品。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Map uncontrolled factors. The authors collect open-weight reasoning models and record their base model, post-training type, framework, decoding settings, prompt treatment, and generation limits.
  1. Measure sensitivity. Nine 1.5B/7B models are run on AIME'24, AMC'23, and MATH500 while seeds, temperature, top-p, hardware, framework, prompt format, and output length are varied. Pass@1 and its variance are the outputs; repeated seeds, rather than a learned verifier, determine uncertainty.
  1. Fix a common protocol. The re-evaluation uses LightEval 0.8.1 with vLLM, model-appropriate templates and tuned decoding, robust LaTeX answer matching, fixed cloud hardware, ten seeds for AIME'24/AIME'25/AMC'23, and three for the other benchmarks.
  1. Reassess training claims. RL and SFT variants are compared with their stated base or instruction-tuned reference on six math benchmarks; mean and standard deviation, not a best single run, determine the reported comparison.
  1. Release audit artifacts. Code, Docker setup, prompts, outputs, leaderboard, and CSV logs are released. Reproduction still requires pinning model revisions, task data, inference engine, seed schedule, and hardware; training data and exact training budgets of third-party models remain unknown.

1. 盘点未控制因素：收集开放权重推理模型，记录基础模型、后训练类型、评测框架、解码、提示和生成长度。
  1. 测量敏感性：在 AIME’24、AMC’23、MATH500 上运行九个 1.5B/7B 模型，改变种子、温度、top-p、硬件、框架、提示和输出长度；输出为 Pass@1 及方差，重复种子而非学习式 verifier 决定不确定性。
  1. 固定共同协议：使用 LightEval 0.8.1、vLLM、模型对应模板和调优解码、LaTeX 答案匹配与固定云端硬件；AIME’24/AIME’25/AMC’23 各十个种子，其余基准各三个。
  1. 重测训练主张：在六个数学基准上，将 RL、SFT 变体与其基础或指令模型比较，以均值和标准差而非最佳单次运行报告结果。
  1. 发布审计产物：公开代码、Docker、提示、输出、榜单和 CSV 日志。复现仍须固定模型版本、任务数据、推理引擎、种子表和硬件；第三方训练数据与预算未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The central claim is that many reported reasoning gains are not robust under a common protocol. In Table 3, the authors evaluate RL and SFT variants on six math benchmarks with LightEval/vLLM, tuned model-specific decoding, suitable templates, 10 seeds for AIME/AMC and 3 for the other tasks. For the R1-Distill-1.5B family, DeepScaleR reaches 37.0±6.6 on AIME'24 versus 28.7±4.8 for R1-Distill, while the paper reports no statistically significant improvement for several other reported RL gains. The same table shows SFT OpenThinker at 30.5±6.2 versus Qwen-Instruct at 12.3±3.2 on AIME'24. This supports a protocol-bound comparison, not a universal verdict on RL or SFT; model families, benchmarks, and training data differ. The sensitivity study explains why: across 20 seeds, Figure 2 reports variation up to 15 percentage points on AIME'24 and 13 on AMC'23, both very small test sets. Because one solved item moves Pass@1 by several points on these sets, this is direct evidence for repeated-run reporting, rather than evidence that any individual score is false.

核心主张是：在共同协议下，许多已报告的推理提升并不稳健。表 3 用 LightEval/vLLM、按模型调优的解码、适配模板、AIME/AMC 十个种子及其余任务三个种子，评测六个数学基准。R1-Distill-1.5B 家族中，DeepScaleR 在 AIME’24 为 37.0±6.6，R1-Distill 为 28.7±4.8；作者称其他若干已报告 RL 提升未达统计显著。表中 SFT 的 OpenThinker 为 30.5±6.2，而 Qwen-Instruct 为 12.3±3.2。证据支持该协议内的比较，不能推成 RL 或 SFT 的普遍结论，因为模型家族、基准与训练数据不同。 敏感性实验解释了原因：图 2 在二十个种子中报告 AIME’24 的波动最高达 15 个百分点、AMC’23 达 13 个百分点；两者都是很小的测试集。 这类集合中只多解对一题便会移动数个百分点，因此证据直接支持重复运行报告，并不等于宣称任何单个分数必然错误。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier reasoning papers usually introduce an RL/SFT recipe and report its own benchmark run, leaving the comparison protocol partly inherited from each project. This paper's change is to treat the protocol itself—seeds, decoding, templates, answer extraction, hardware, and software—as the object of controlled study, then re-run heterogeneous methods on it. Its novelty is not a new reasoning trainer or benchmark: it makes variance and comparability first-class evidence for judging claimed progress. Docker packaging and multi-seed reporting are individually familiar practices; the distinctive contribution is applying their joint audit to current reasoning-method claims and releasing the resulting run-level record. It therefore changes the decision rule for progress: a headline score must survive a disclosed, matched protocol before it is treated as comparative evidence.

已有推理论文通常提出 RL/SFT 配方，并报告各自项目中的基准运行，比较协议却部分沿用项目自身设置。本文真正改变的是把协议本身——种子、解码、模板、答案提取、硬件和软件——作为受控研究对象，再在其上重跑异构方法。它的新意不是提出训练器或新基准，而是把方差与可比性变成判断“进展”是否成立的一等证据。 Docker 打包和多种子报告本身并不新；区别在于作者把二者联合用于审计当下推理方法主张，并公开得到的运行级记录。 由此改变了进展的判断规则：只有在披露且匹配的共同协议下仍成立，榜单高分才能作为比较证据被接受。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The authors study open-weight models and mathematical benchmarks, so their RL-versus-SFT findings do not establish the same ordering for closed models, non-math domains, or another evaluation budget. Reuse should retain this scope instead of presenting the table as a general training-law result.

The standardized stack reduces but does not erase uncertainty: AIME'24 and AMC'23 contain only 30 and 40 examples, and the reported protocol still selects model-specific hyperparameters. Before comparing a new method, audit the benchmark size, seed distribution, prompt/answer-extraction implementation, model revision, and whether the tuning budget was comparable. The authors also release evaluation artifacts rather than the third-party training corpora behind every model, so the audit can establish evaluation robustness but cannot reconstruct data lineage or isolate every training-side cause.

作者研究的是开放权重模型和数学基准，因此 RL 与 SFT 的比较不能证明在闭源模型、非数学领域或另一种评测预算下仍有相同排序。复用时应保留这一范围，不能把表中结果表述为普遍训练规律。

标准化运行栈降低而未消除不确定性：AIME’24 与 AMC’23 分别仅有 30、40 题，且协议仍按模型选择超参数。比较新方法前，应审计基准规模、种子分布、提示与答案提取实现、模型版本，以及调优预算是否可比。 作者公开的是评测产物，而非每个第三方模型背后的训练语料；该审计能建立评测稳健性，却不能重建数据血缘或隔离全部训练侧原因。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
If you are evaluating a new math-reasoning model, use the released Docker/LightEval recipe, task definitions, templates, and seed schedule to produce mean±standard-deviation Pass@1 rather than one leaderboard score. The required inputs are a pinned model revision, the six benchmark datasets, comparable decoding budget, and compatible hardware; the output is an auditable evaluation report. Success means the run is reproducible and its confidence interval is reported.

If you curate a reasoning-training claim, use the CSV logs to inspect whether a gain survives across seeds and newer AIME'25. Do not reuse this protocol unchanged for non-math tasks or claim causal superiority of RL/SFT when base model, data scale, or tuning budget differ. For a paper review, the minimum audit artifact is therefore a runnable command plus raw per-seed outputs, not only an aggregate table or a screenshot of a leaderboard.

若要评测新的数学推理模型，可复用 Docker/LightEval 配方、任务定义、模板和种子表，以均值±标准差而非单个榜单分数输出结果。输入需固定模型版本、六个基准、可比的解码预算和兼容硬件；输出是可审计评测报告。成功标准是运行可复现且报告置信信息。

若要审计推理训练主张，可用 CSV 日志检查提升是否跨种子和更新的 AIME’25 存在。非数学任务不可原样照搬；当基础模型、数据规模或调优预算不同，也不可借此断言 RL/SFT 的因果优劣。 若用于论文审阅，最低审计产物应是可运行命令和逐种子原始输出，而不只是汇总表或榜单截图。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: it audits mathematical-reasoning progress by standardizing the evaluation conditions that can otherwise create apparent gains.
  1. Method handle: vary seeds, decoding, templates, answer matching, and stack first; then compare methods under one protocol. Multi-seed averaging is the key quality gate.
  1. Artifact handle: Sober Reasoning releases Docker evaluation code, prompts, outputs, a leaderboard, and an MIT CSV dataset with 65.6k log rows; it is an evaluation-log dataset, not training traces.
  1. Evidence anchor: Table 3 uses six benchmarks, 10 seeds for AIME/AMC and 3 elsewhere; DeepScaleR is 37.0±6.6 versus R1-Distill 28.7±4.8 on AIME'24, while several claimed RL gains are not significant.
  1. Reuse decision: use it to audit a math leaderboard before accepting a training claim; first match model revision, prompt, decoding budget, answer extractor, seeds, and benchmark version.

The 30/40-example AIME'24/AMC'23 sets are specifically too small for a one-run ranking; report the variance even if a model's mean is higher.

1. 定位：它通过统一会制造表面提升的评测条件，审计数学推理进展。
  1. 方法抓手：先改变种子、解码、模板、答案匹配和运行栈，再在同一协议下比较方法；多种子平均是关键质量门槛。
  1. 产物抓手：Sober Reasoning 公开 Docker 评测代码、提示、输出、榜单和 MIT 许可的 65.6k 条 CSV 日志；它是评测日志，不是训练轨迹。
  1. 证据锚点：表 3 覆盖六个基准，AIME/AMC 各十个种子、其余各三个；AIME’24 上 DeepScaleR 为 37.0±6.6，R1-Distill 为 28.7±4.8，而若干 RL 提升不显著。
  1. 复用决定：适合在接受训练主张前审计数学榜单；先对齐模型版本、提示、解码预算、答案提取器、种子和基准版本。

AIME’24/AMC’23 分别只有三十、四十题，单次排名不足取；即使均值更高，也应报告方差。
